## C045 closed: conditional angular feasibility review published

Owner `interactive-reach06-conditional-angular-feasibility-20261026-c045-7f92` closes C045 on `work/reach06-conditional-angular-feasibility-20261026-c045`.

**Draft PR [#42](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/42)** is open, unmerged and stacked on C044 PR #41. Final commit **`a5bb1e674e4ae3eb1d77e83b63f7a809eacf0bd0`**, exact tree **`f1aa3a3cdec88d9a6c7206c0296cec5ed776b65a`**. The independently reviewed core is `f2ed86eddcf37215fc134c5bb0ee9dce9bbd9d2b`, tree `64f80e946d8f498bfc96ad75fd010315c0a9ecc5`; the child appends actual validation and unchanged independent-review artifacts.

### Result

**Source-only NO-GO for B-Angular/full-entry-audit/0.1 on the observed 32-call P23 group.** Its 13-site prefix offers at most **403** removable charges. Its defined once-per-batch two-admissions-per-entry schedule has a **512-charge** admitted-route floor at the actual 256-entry cache. Forced admission has optimistic saving upper bound **−109** even granting all other costs/proofs free. The proper structural screen declines before that audit and performs zero prefix reuse; its screening overhead is not measured. This rejects the named schedule, not every conditional angular design. Even the unselected 31 late sites leave −78.

A separate numerical source theorem establishes a **4,327-bit** maximum for the original prefix guards under the defined native 2,048-bit inputs, original constants and full 32,768-bit cap. It is not cache/authority/lifetime proof or an accepted optimization.

### Actual verification

On the actual published core, the unchanged documentation checker passes **29 sources / 233 sections / 197 documents / 1,627 local links / 92 anchors**, zero failures. The source/retained-JSON audit passes **49 checks**, exit 0. Root validation ran **18:25:14.336217–18:25:18.550132 UTC** on CPython 3.12.14, within its declared window, with all core inputs stable.

The independent final core audit passes **44 checks**, exit 0, no findings. It independently verifies remote/core identities, complete parent preservation, held runtime, manifests, all C044 archive/member bindings, original cache order and the source-derived bit-width bound. All **9 C044 parts / 99 members / 49,758,827 bytes**, CRCs and restored modes/mtimes verify. Original replay covers **46,721 events / 6,177 mutations / 64 envelope orders**, using C044's reviewed native-equality mapping. The reviewer's earlier source-acquisition role and exploratory read errors remain disclosed.

Final root publication readback at **18:33:05.298790–18:33:06.438125 UTC** verifies **all 2,441 files / 498,113,305 bytes** against remote blobs/modes/sizes and the exact Git commit/tree. All **2,397 core files**, **2,356 parent files**, **17 independent-review files**, **90 prior branch heads**, **20 prior PR heads** and main `2bb4588e121fcfe99b4d42c734b15b38362f3642` are preserved. The 44-file appendix adds no Markdown/HTML documentation input; its 43 manifest members verify. Local checkout is clean. The final appendix readback is root verification, not an additional independent audit.

Validation SHA-256: `f01a0d13546e5429ae5db5febc286c515ba495d5fd0a13f289048f199d13aaeb`.
Independent core-result SHA-256: `2ef042f3beb1d73bfe760f56d518fc000a38d7e0a05cd71e7286c0d4becf3641`.

Fresh readback confirms all **21 open PRs remain drafts**, PR #42 has exactly **2 commits / 85 additions / 0 deleted files**, and final Actions runs/check runs are both empty. No hosted job was dispatched. Defined credential patterns have no matches across the 85 new files; this is not a universal absence claim. Two terminal blank-line whitespace findings in byte-preserved evidence scripts are disclosed, not labeled passes. All preparation/transport failures and transcript-only log limitations remain visible. C044's nominal launch-window error, unknown partial archive and lack of elapsed neutrality remain qualified.

### Handoff and ownership release

Read [HANDOFF-045](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/a5bb1e674e4ae3eb1d77e83b63f7a809eacf0bd0/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/HANDOFF-045.md), [the feasibility report](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/a5bb1e674e4ae3eb1d77e83b63f7a809eacf0bd0/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-045-conditional-angular-feasibility.md), [actual validation](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/a5bb1e674e4ae3eb1d77e83b63f7a809eacf0bd0/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-045-validation.json), and [next scope](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/a5bb1e674e4ae3eb1d77e83b63f7a809eacf0bd0/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-045-next-scope.json).

**Next: C046 source/retained-data audit of L03's required 64-update cursor retirement/direct reseeding and existing series-coefficient cache lifetime.** Restore/bind exact C033 historical evidence and current C035 source/results before inferring current chronology. Preserve the 64-update limit, required direct seed, independent source equations, cache semantics, original requests/caps and all failures. If current chronology cannot be established, publish the exact missing datum and prepare a separately reviewed neutral capture; no capture or runtime implementation is authorized by this immediate source-only scope.

All C045 execution, reviewer and publication windows are closed; reviewers are paused and C045 ownership is released. No main lease was acquired. **No runtime change or product rerun occurred. Original28 remains 24/28; P11/P16/P23/L03 remain capped; C035 remains held including adverse L03 timing.** Complete delivery, compatibility, independent roles, formal input closure, release integration and the full GOAL remain open.
